items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: C.L. asked me if I wanted to work in his band, because the trumpet player he was was George Arndorff

ctx.x: But then I guess at that time a lot of musicians were working in the defense plants and playing gigs at night.
April of the next year, which is 1943 now, C.L. asked me if I wanted to work in his band, because the trumpet player he was was George Arndorff--do you know him?
